channel.title: BMX All Stars
channel.desc: The biggest races of the year are finally here for our BMX riders as they travel to Scotland to compete in the World Championships for their countries. After a brutally stormy last training session, they?ll be taking on the best riders in the world. It?s Adele?s first ever World Championships. And, to add to the pressure, she?s representing her home country Italy. She?s the only young female Italian rider here so can she make her country, club and family proud? UK number 1 Ti has dreams of becoming World number 1. At the last World Championships he went out in the quarters, but he?s been training hard and is determined to do better this time. But he?s up against the best riders in the world and when there?s a massive crash in the final, it threatens to jeopardise all that he has been working for. Can he get through and bag a spot on the podium? Featuring Olympians Kye Whyte and Quillan Isidore and BMXer Tian Isidore Narrated by Ashley Walters.
